title: A chain of distances
hook: Explore the evidence behind a cosmic question.

knows: Light and gravity help astronomers study the universe.
doesNotKnow: Different distance techniques work over different ranges. Nearby measurements can calibrate methods that extend farther, forming a chain of related measurements.

misconception: A learner may choose: A single ruler can be physically placed across the universe
objective: Use the visual model to reason about: Why do astronomers speak of a cosmic distance ladder?

claims.text: Question, correct answer and explanation: Why do astronomers speak of a cosmic distance ladder? Different methods calibrate one another across distance ranges. Different distance techniques work over different ranges. Nearby measurements can calibrate methods that extend farther, forming a chain of related measurements.
